ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The image shows an acyl bromide-like structure. An R group is bonded to a carbon that also bears H and is bonded to a carbonyl carbon. The carbonyl carbon is double-bonded to O and single-bonded to Br. A separate bromide ion, Br with a negative charge, is drawn nearby. Curved arrows are present, but the question says to ignore them. Reasoning: Replacing the R group with the SMILES wildcard '*' gives the connected fragment *CC(=O)Br. The separate bromide ion is represented as [Br-] and is separated from the neutral fragment with a dot. Therefore the SMILES is *CC(=O)Br.[Br-].
